headline: Flutterwave Expands Services to Address Cross-Border Payment Friction in Africa
summary: African fintech firm Flutterwave is focusing on expanding corporate treasury holding and settlement services. The initiative aims to resolve regional cross-border movement barriers for businesses.
why: Flutterwave is one of Africa's largest payments infrastructure platforms. Intracontinental payment barriers add transaction friction for companies operating in multiple African currencies.

impacts.name: Flutterwave
impacts.why: Expanding into treasury management diversifies revenue beyond transactional processing fees.
